verdict.rationale: jo is explicitly a built-in AI assistant/agent that users delegate tasks to — scheduling briefings, building websites, managing Linear/GitHub, decks, and running autonomously overnight on its own cloud machine, all documented in first-party docs and confirmed live via probes. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of task delegation actually working, and clearer detail on failure/error handling when delegated tasks go wrong.
